about:
RockAuto, LLC operates as an online auto parts retailer from its headquarters in Madison, Wisconsin. The company was founded to provide a comprehensive digital catalog of automotive replacement parts, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The company maintains an extensive online catalog covering hundreds of vehicle makes, from classic brands like Packard and Studebaker to current manufacturers such as Tesla and Rivian. RockAuto does not manufacture parts itself; instead, it sources components from established brands like Fel-Pro and offers them alongside real-time price comparisons against competitors including Advance Auto Parts, AutoZone, O'Reilly, and NAPA. The platform allows customers to select a vehicle, view compatible parts with pricing, and place orders for shipment to destinations worldwide based on country and postal code.

RockAuto serves individual vehicle owners, independent repair shops, and fleet operators seeking replacement parts for maintenance and repair. Its catalog spans passenger cars, light trucks, and commercial vehicles across domestic and import nameplates.

The company emphasizes in-stock availability and transparent pricing, displaying regular prices alongside its own for direct comparison. A 'Buy Now, Pay Later' option allows qualified purchasers to split payments into four interest-free installments.
